role: Quality gate filtering observations at Layer 2/Layer 3 boundary before ingestion.
detail: Exports ObservationValidator class that applies four independent validation checks to observations: min_area_fraction (rejects sub-pixel artifacts), min_confidence (rejects low-confidence detections), embedding_norm (rejects degenerate embedding vectors, checks both under-min and over-max), and aspect_ratio (rejects pathological bounding boxes, checks both under-min and over-max). Also exports ValidationResult dataclass capturing pass/fail status and list of rejection reasons. Validator maintains cumulative counters for all observations validated and rejections by each check reason. All checks are computationally trivial (no I/O, no ML inference). Validation can be disabled entirely via config.enabled flag. Filter method is primary pipeline entry point, returning only passing observations.
constants: (checks configured in ValidationConfig: min_area_fraction, min_confidence, embedding_norm_min, embedding_norm_max, min_aspect_ratio, max_aspect_ratio)
gotchas: Embedding norm check only applies when observation has embedding present (checked via obs.embedding is not None and len > 0). Aspect ratio check only applies when bbox_height > 0 to avoid division by zero. Cumulative counters are never reset during validator lifetime. When validation disabled, validate() returns passing result without incrementing any counters.
